name: Dimension
mood: Dusk-lit dark AI workspace with matte-black canvas, frosted glass panels, 9999px pill controls, medium-weight DM Sans hero type, warm gray copy, and a single violet glow used only in gradients.

inkBlack.role: Icon strokes, SVG fills, and deep contrast details on light surfaces.

voidCanvas.role: Primary page background and dark UI shell.

graphite.role: Elevated dark surface for nav, panels, modals, and cards.

slate.role: Muted text, metadata, timestamps, and quiet links.

smoke.role: Disabled text and idle integration labels.

ash.role: Secondary body text, helper copy, and de-emphasized labels.

frostedGlass.role: Translucent panel fill at 10 percent opacity over dark surfaces.

hairline.role: 1px borders on dark-surface controls and glass panels.

bone.role: Primary readable text on dark surfaces, softer than pure white.

snowWhite.role: Primary CTA fill, strong headline text, and inverted card surfaces.

duskViolet.role: The only chromatic accent; use at partial opacity in glow or gradient washes only.

rules: Use DM Sans for display, body, navigation, buttons, and most UI.
Set hero display type at weight 500, not bold.
Use Geist for feature headings and product-aware editorial sections.
Use tighter tracking at 72px and 40px display sizes.
Do not use 700 or heavier for hero text.

components.name: White Pill CTA
components.recipe: Snow White fill, Graphite text, 9999px radius, 8px vertical and 12px horizontal padding, DM Sans 14px to 16px.

components.name: Ghost Nav Button
components.recipe: Transparent fill, reduced-opacity white text, 1px Hairline border, 9999px radius, 6px vertical and 14px horizontal padding.

components.name: Floating Frosted Nav
components.recipe: Graphite or translucent Graphite, 19px asymmetric radius, 4px backdrop blur, 1px Hairline border, compact pill links.

components.name: Hairline Ghost Button
components.recipe: Transparent fill, Bone or Smoke text, 1px Hairline border, 10px radius, tight 8px padding.

components.name: Frosted Glass Feature Card
components.recipe: Frosted Glass at 10 percent opacity over Void Canvas, 24px radius, translucent Hairline border, no shadow, optional 4px backdrop blur.

components.name: Gradient Hero Panel
components.recipe: Warm amber/coral to cobalt atmosphere, 72px DM Sans display text, compact bullet list, white pill CTA, product mockup.

components.name: Numbered Accordion Row
components.recipe: Bone title left, Ash two-digit number right, no background, no card shell, 20px row rhythm.

components.name: Bulleted Feature Row
components.recipe: Small monochrome icon, 16px DM Sans Bone text, 12px gap, no background.

components.name: Device Mockup Frame
components.recipe: Large product frame with 40px top corners and 0px bottom corners; screenshot bleeds to edges.

components.name: Status Banner Pill
components.recipe: Dark or translucent top announcement pill, 9999px radius, icon, text, arrow, compact spacing.

components.name: Section Header
components.recipe: Geist 32px/600 or 36px/500 in Bone, followed by 18px supporting text in Ash.

components.name: Icon Glyph
components.recipe: Monochrome geometric icon, 16px to 20px, 1.5px stroke, optional 4px squircle container.

do: Use 9999px radius for primary buttons, nav links, and pill tags.
Set display headlines in DM Sans 72px, weight 500, with -2.52px tracking.
Use Bone for readable text instead of pure white body copy.
Use 1px Hairline borders on dark-surface controls.
Apply warm-to-cool gradients only to hero or spotlight sections.
Use Dusk Violet only in gradient washes or glows.
Use translucency and backdrop blur for depth.
dont: Do not use box-shadow for elevation.
Do not introduce additional brand colors.
Do not use Dusk Violet as a solid fill, text color, button, or card background.
Do not use 700 or heavier hero typography.
Do not place large white cards directly on Void Canvas unless they are product mockups.
Do not make every card frosted; reserve glass for feature panels and navigation.
Do not add photographic hero imagery.
